author: Phobiaxx
body:
Original:
So, recently, I submitted a report, and it was denied. I still have some things to say about it, and  I had a question relevant to the report that wasn't answered... Also, I have a feeling the mod who viewed it didn't see my link to to an album full of images... and.... the mod doesnt have a Skype on their profile.
Suggestion: Could you guys not lock the report threads right after you respond? Sometimes the players still have more to say...
Thanks.
NEW EDIT:
Suggestion:Add a tag for the reports section, for mods+ to add a tag 'finished' but not a lock, if the player requests the mod not to lock along with his/her report, once the report has been reviewed and responded to.
This way, mods can see which ones need to be looked at, and players can leave feedback to their report's response(questions, comments, and concerns)
And... yah.
(I hope I make sense, very sleeepy atm)

replies.author: Lieutenantpants
replies.body: You can always email support@avicus.net if you don't like how a report was dealt with, or if you have a question about something. Locking a report thread signifies that it has been dealt with, telling other moderators that they can move on to other reports. If they were left open, moderators would have to check every single open report, and some of them would likely have been previously dealt with. This would just waste time. It's a nice idea, but it simply isn't practical for the amount of reports that are filed every day.
